paragraphs: Casepoint sells a cloud platform for eDiscovery, FOIA, investigations, and compliance work. Inside it, teams collect, process, analyze, review, and produce data in one place. The pitch is that all the data for a matter is managed in one place rather than moved between tools.

Connectors pull data straight from platforms such as Slack, Microsoft 365, and Teams. The processing engine supports over 600 file types. A separate FOIA product is built around how agencies respond to public records requests. Requesters use a portal to file requests and pay for them through pay.gov. For Canada, ATIPXpress carries access and privacy requests from submission through search, review, redaction, exemption analysis, and delivery.

The company describes the platform as purpose-built for corporations and government entities. It states that Casepoint holds FedRAMP Moderate and High authorizations, ISO 27001 certification, and Department of Defense Impact Level 5 and Impact Level 6 authorizations. It also claims to be one of only six SaaS companies globally with DOD IL6 authorization. Its AI is described as built for legal and regulatory work.

quote.text: Casepoint is Purpose-Built for Corporations and Government Entities
